description_en: Adds risk items to the whitelist or removes risk items from the whitelist by specifying servers and risk items
description_zh: 指定需要忽略的服务器列表和检查项列表，对风险项进行加白和取消加白操作
name: IgnoreCheckItems

parameters.help_en:
The UUIDs of the servers.

You can call the [DescribeCloudCenterInstances](~~DescribeCloudCenterInstances~~) operation to query the UUIDs of servers
parameters.help_zh:
指定要忽略的服务器UUID列表。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141932.html接口获取服务器的UUID
parameters.name: uuid_list

fields.help_en: The ID of the check item
fields.name: check_id

fields.help_en: The baseline type of the check item
fields.name: risk_type

parameters.help_zh: 指定需要忽略的检查项列表
parameters.name: check_and_risk_type_list

parameters.help_en:
The operation that you want to perform on the risk item.Valid values:
1: adds the risk item to the whitelist
2: removes the risk item from the whitelist
parameters.help_zh:
操作类型。取值如下：
1：忽略
2：取消忽略
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The reason why you add the risk item to the whitelist
parameters.name: reason

parameters.help_en:
The language of the content within the request and response. Default value: zh. Valid values:

zh: Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为zh。取值：
zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The data source. Valid values:

default: host baseline
agentless: agentless baseline
parameters.help_zh:
数据来源。取值：
default：主机基线
agentless：agentless基线
parameters.name: source

fields.help_en: The names of the containers that need to be whitelisted for the current asset, separated by English commas
fields.help_zh: 当前资产需要加白的容器名称，英文逗号分割
fields.name: container_names

fields.help_en:
The UUID of the server.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141932.html operation to query the UUIDs of servers
fields.help_zh:
资产的UUID。
调用[DescribeCloudCenterInstances](~~DescribeCloudCenterInstances~~)接口获取该参数
fields.name: uuid

parameters.help_en: List of container names that need to be whitelisted
parameters.help_zh: 需要加白的容器名称列表
parameters.name: container_items

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request, which is used to locate and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
